groups.title: CSS in Astro
groups.question: A component's style needs to affect Markdown content rendered inside it, and the site needs a CSS reset applied everywhere. Explain scoped and global styles in Astro.

followUps.Scoped Styles and :global(): Why don't scoped styles reach rendered Markdown, and how does :global() help?
followUps.Global Stylesheets: Where should global stylesheets be imported?

evidence.text: Scoped styles only apply to elements in the component's own template.
Rendered Markdown and child components are outside that scope.
:global() lets a selector reach them deliberately.
Global CSS is imported once, usually in a layout.
It then applies to every page that uses the layout.
Importing it in many components is unnecessary.

groups.title: Tailwind CSS Integration
groups.question: You are adding Tailwind to your Astro site with brand colors and spacing. Explain how the integration and configuration work.

followUps.Tailwind with Astro Integration: What does the Tailwind integration set up?
followUps.Tailwind Configuration and Design Tokens: How do you add brand colors and spacing to Tailwind?

evidence.text: It configures Tailwind in Astro's build pipeline.
It injects Tailwind's base, component and utility styles.
This avoids setting up PostCSS by hand.
Custom values are added in the Tailwind configuration.
They become utilities like bg-brand.
Using them instead of hard-coded values keeps the design consistent.

notEnough: Only saying you edit the config.

groups.title: Design Systems
groups.question: Your design system's colors and spacing must be shared across components, and users want a dark mode toggle. Explain design tokens and dark mode.

followUps.CSS Custom Properties as Design Tokens: Why define design tokens as CSS custom properties?
followUps.Dark Mode with CSS and Tailwind: How would you implement dark mode?

evidence.text: Tokens are defined once as variables on :root.
They are the single source of truth for colors, spacing and typography.
Both CSS and JavaScript can read them.
prefers-color-scheme follows the user's system setting.
A dark class on the root, toggled by code, gives manual control.
Switching token values or dark: variants changes the whole theme.

notEnough: Only saying you add dark styles.

groups.title: CSS Architecture
groups.question: Some styles look broken in older browsers, and utility classes keep losing to component styles. Explain how CSS processing and layers help.

followUps.PostCSS and CSS Processing: What does PostCSS do in an Astro project?
followUps.CSS Layers and Specificity Control: How does @layer control which styles win?

evidence.text: Astro runs CSS through PostCSS.
Autoprefixer adds vendor prefixes for browser compatibility.
Plugins enable features like nesting.
@layer groups styles into named layers.
Layer order decides priority, regardless of selector specificity.
This stops specificity fights between resets, components and utilities.
